summary: The PR addresses the issue of adding a legend to a SubFigure by modifying the Legend class to accept FigureBase as a parent. The tests provided cover the new functionality.

issues.description: The PR includes additional test files that are not part of the source code change. While these are helpful, they should be added in a separate PR or as part of the test suite setup.
The error message could be updated to reflect the new accepted type, e.g., 'Legend needs either Axes or FigureBase as parent'.
